policy.cohort: warm first unseen target, all targets in denominator
policy.transition: adjacent distinct timestamp buckets; all distinct cross-bucket item pairs except self
policy.same_timestamp: one unordered bucket; no within-bucket transition or order
policy.score: mean source-to-destination transition probability per bucket; sum weighted buckets
policy.seen_filter: entire train-time user history, no fallback
policy.selection: ordered pooled integer hits@100, hits@1000, smaller H, smaller decay; equal control at same H
policy.tie_break: descending score, ascending string item ID
